items.question: Why did Marvin have to write his report a second time?
options: A He did not write about the right topic.
B Mrs. North could not read his writing.
C He forgot to write 'The End' at the bottom.
D He finished the report after the bell rang.

items.question: Mrs. North said that left-handed people have royal blood. How did this make Marvin feel?
options: A He felt proud and slowed down his writing.
B He felt angry and put down his pencil.
C He felt worried because he was not royal.
D He felt better, but he still wrote as fast as he could.

items.question: Why was Marvin writing his report as fast as he could the second time?
options: A He wanted to go outside before the bell rang.
B Mrs. North told him it was a race.
C He felt he needed to catch up with everyone else.
D He was left-handed and could not write slowly.

items.question: What does Marvin look like, and why might this be important in the story? Tell where in the chapter you found your answer.
At the end of the chapter, we learn that Marvin lives near Washington, D.C. Why is this detail important? Use what you know from the whole chapter to explain your answer.
